query: My tomato plants finally sprouted the first little red fruits this morning, I’ve been tending to them every single day for two whole months, I was so worried the recent heatwave would have scorched them before they got to ripen. I also just found a super cute ceramic cat planter at the weekend flea market that’s perfect for the small basil seedling I picked up last week, I can’t wait to repot it once I have a spare minute after work.
